- Entry signal: range-box breakout. The box is the highest high and lowest low of the 16 bars before the current bar. It only counts as a box if its height (top minus bottom) is at most 3 times the current ATR(14). Bullish when the close is strictly above the top of a valid box; bearish when the close is strictly below its bottom.
- Direction: long only (bearish signals only close longs).
- Trend filter on completed 60-minute candles: only take long entries when the last completed 60-minute close is strictly above the 20-period EMA of those candles' closes, and only take short entries when it is strictly below. The filter only blocks entries, never exits.
- Position size: start with 0.5 of equity, then pyramid. While in the trade, each time the close is at least 1 x the entry ATR beyond the price of the last add (initially the entry price) in the trade's favour, add another 0.5 (total capped at 1.0), at most 2 add(s) per trade; the add price becomes that bar's close.
- Moving box: the trade lives in a box anchored at the entry price, with the stop 2 x entry ATR behind the anchor and the target 3 x entry ATR beyond it. Every time a bar closes at least another 1 x entry ATR in profit beyond the current anchor, shift the whole box (anchor, stop and target) 1 x entry ATR in the trade's favour (repeat if the close cleared several steps). The box never shifts back.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

- Breakeven: once a bar closes at least 2 x entry ATR in profit, move the stop to the entry price for the rest of the trade (it never moves back).
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.
